notes.title: Release Date & New Trailer
notes.notes: [p]Hello there fisherpeople! Let's see what we caught in our net.[/p][p][/p][h2]Release Date[/h2][p]Salty news for y'all: the Loan Shark is coming for payback on [b]8th August 2025[/b]![/p][p]Get ready for a fishing trip amidst water, debt, and blood.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Trailer[/h2][p]To celebrate the announcement of the release date, we put up an updated version of our trailer.[/p][p]It shares the same structure and beats as the previous one, but showcases all the little tweaks we made to improve the look of the game.[/p][p]Let us know what you think![/p][h2][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/y6Q1gFEot3I"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Stay fishy and wishlist our game![/p][p]- Studio Carota[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
